components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid violet CTA for Invite and primary conversions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.7rem 1.35rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; border: none; background: #5835A5; color: #fff; font: 600 0.9375rem/1.2 "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4A2C8C; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5835A5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.7rem 1.35rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid #DCD7CD; background: transparent; color: #191817; font: 600 0.9375rem/1.2 "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #9c978d; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5835A5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #DCD7CD; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 1.5rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(25 24 23 / 0.04), 0 8px 24px rgb(25 24 23 / 0.06); } .ds-eyebrow { margin: 0; font: 600 0.75rem/1.2 "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5835A5; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0.75rem 0 0; font: 600 1.25rem/1.2 "Source Serif 4", Georgia, serif; color: #191817; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0.75rem 0 0; font: 400 0.98rem/1.65 "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; color: #625F59; }

narrative.overview: Premium personal-authority publication feel: warm paper, charcoal type, deep violet action, sparingly used gold. Serif ideas, sans interface. Speaking-first, not VC or startup costume.
keyCharacteristics: Deep violet as sole primary action color
Generous spacing; thin dividers; restrained cards

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Violet owns interactive emphasis. Gold is rare editorial ornament.

rules.name: The Viewport Hero Rule
rules.body: Hero messaging and primary CTA fit roughly one desktop viewport.

dos: Do lead with speaking invitation and real talks, biography, and founded companies.
Do keep John Chisholm Ventures quiet in the footer.
Do mark missing testimonials as placeholders.
donts: Don't present an active VC fund or pitch portal.
Don't use carousels, autoplay video, or startup gradients.
Don't lead with an article archive or use JCV as primary homepage identity.
